_comment: Fill in real credentials here. NEVER commit real tokens; add config.json to .gitignore for this workflow.

newsapi._help: newsapi.org → Get API Key. Free tier is rate-limited and delayed ~24h on some plans -- note that limitation in anything built from this data.

_help_wire: PR Newswire / Business Wire / GlobeNewswire don't publish a uniform public API -- most require a sales-negotiated contract. Get endpoint_base/submit_path/api_key from your actual vendor's own API documentation once that contract exists. write_access_confirmed is a separate, explicit opt-in -- leave it false until you've verified the vendor relationship and credentials are real.
